# faraday_target (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "faraday_cohort" "customers" {
  name        = "customers"
  stream_name = "orders"
}

resource "faraday_scope" "export" {
  name    = "export"
  preview = true
  population = {
    cohort_ids = [faraday_cohort.customers.id]
  }
  payload = {}
}

resource "faraday_target" "csv" {
  name     = "csv"
  scope_id = faraday_scope.export.id
  representation = {
    identified = {
      aggregate = "person"
    }
  }
  options = {
    hosted_csv = {}
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-friendly name of the target.
- `options` (Attributes) The export target configuration options. These vary by connection type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))
- `representation` (Attributes) Choose how the scopes's output should be formatted for this target. The following **modes** are available: **`aggregated`** * This option will produce one row per geographical area. * This option is best for geo-targeted ad campaigns. **`hashed`** * Faraday's name, physical address, and email is emitted in hashed form. Data is randomly ordered to prevent re-identification. All payload columns are emitted except raw propensity scores and attributes. * This option facilitates digital acquisition use cases. **`identified`** * All identifiable information specified by `identity_sets` in source data is emitted in cleartext - see <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createdataset">/datasets</a> for more detail. All payload columns are emitted. Your account may have a limit on how many rows can be returned. * This option is best for direct mail and canvassing campaigns. **`referenced`** * This option will produce one row per person based on the identifier column of a dataset of your choice. To protect privacy, this will not include identifying information other than the key you select. * This option is best for merging data back into your stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--representation))
- `scope_id` (String) The UUID of a scope - see <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createscope">/scopes</a> for more detail.

### Optional

- `analysis_config` (Attributes) Configuration for the analysis of the target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--analysis_config))
- `connection_id` (String) If this is a replication (externally-hosted) target, the UUID of a connection - see <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createconnection">/connections</a> for more detail. If this is not a replication target, omit this parameter.
- `custom_structure` (Attributes List) By default, targets include all columns in <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createtargetpreview">the target preview</a>, with no name changes. Users may use this parameter to specify their own set of "structure transformations" to override the default selection, order, and name of exported columns. The shape of this parameter is an array of objects where the order of the columns to export is given by the order of the array. Each item represents a 1:1 mapping of scope input column to target output column. Only those columns specified here are emitted in the target output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_structure))
- `filter` (Attributes) Filter the rows exported in a target using the scope payload elements. - **Deprecated:** To filter by outcome scores, use `outcome_score`. - To filter by outcome probability, use `outcome_probability`. - To filter by outcome percentile, use `outcome_percentile`. - To filter by persona set persona id, use `persona`. - To filter by cohort membership, use `cohort_membership`. The cohort does not need to be in the scope payload. - To filter by trait, use `trait`. - To filter by attribute, use `attribute`. - To filter by recommender uncalibrated probability, use `recommender_uncalibrated_probability`. - To filter by recommender rank, use `recommender_rank`. Conditions are AND-ed together (like SQL) - each condition applies an additional constraint. Nulls are excluded unless explicitly requested with `_null: true`. Target filters are not supported for targets with options.type = "lookup_api". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `human_readable` (Boolean) By default, column names are exported in a machine-readable format with underscored uuids. Setting this to `true` replaces ids with literates in the exported column names.
- `limit` (Attributes) Restrict the number of rows exported in a target. - To apply an absolute row limit, use `row_count`. - **Deprecated:** To filter by percentile scores, use `percentile` (use `filter outcome_percentile` instead). Target limits are not supported for targets with options.type = "lookup_api" (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limit))
- `payload_map` (Map of String) **Deprecated: use `custom_structure`.** By default, targets include all columns in <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createtargetpreview">the target preview</a>, with no name changes. This parameter is an override of the default that enables an explicit mapping of columns that should be included in the target export, along with the exported column name. Each key is the name the column originally had, and each value is the desired name. Example: ``` { "person_first_name": "first_name", "person_last_name": "last_name", "city": "city" } ``` In the example above, the target will only include the "first_name", "last_name", and "city" columns.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If not null, this resource will no longer receive updates, but will still be visable.
- `created_at` (String) When this resource was created.
- `final_structure` (Attributes List) Final structure of the target export. This is only included in the response if the target is built. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--final_structure))
- `id` (String) A unique ID for this resource.
- `last_read_input_at` (String) The last time this resource's input was read.
- `last_updated_config_at` (String) The last time this resource's configuration was updated. If this is more recent than last_updated_output_at, the resource will be rebuilt.
- `last_updated_output_at` (String) The last time this resource successfully built.
- `managed` (Boolean) A managed target requires special configuration from a Faraday admin, and is read-only.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of this resource.
- `status` (String) The current state of this resource and any updates.
- `status_changed_at` (String) When the status of this resource was last updated.
- `status_error` (String) If this resource has `status == "error"`, this will contain an error message.
- `target_count` (Number) The number of records in the target. This is only included in the response if the target is built.
- `updated_at` (String) When this resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--options--bigquery"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.bigquery`

Required:

Optional:

- `day_partitioned` (Boolean) Date-based partitioning allows the data to be <a href ="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/partitioned-tables#date_timestamp_partitioned_tables">partitioned by date</a>. This will appear as a `fdy_batch_date` column.

<a id="nestedatt--representation--aggregated"></a>
### Nested Schema for `representation.aggregated`

Required:

- `aggregate` (String) Available aggregation levels for data exported in `aggregated` targets.

Optional:

- `include_geometry` (Boolean) Include the geometry of the geographic area in the target output.
- `transform_preset` (String) One of: * default: Faraday default aggregated representation * google_ads: Aggregated upload format for Google Ads If not specified `default` is used.


<a id="nestedatt--representation--hashed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `representation.hashed`

Optional:

- `impute_payload` (List of String) Which payload elements to include imputed values for. Imputation uses cohabitants and neighbors to estimate missing values. Empty array means no imputed values appear in the target's payload.
- `transform_preset` (String) One of: * default: Faraday default hashed representation * linkedin: Hashed upload format for Linkedin * taboola: Hashed upload format for Taboola * snapchat: Hashed upload format for Snapchat * tiktok: Hashed upload format for Tiktok * pinterest: Hashed upload format for Pinterest * youtube: Hashed upload format for Youtube * google_ads: Hashed upload format for Google Ads * facebook: Hashed upload format for Facebook If not specified `default` is used.


<a id="nestedatt--representation--identified"></a>
### Nested Schema for `representation.identified`

Required:

- `aggregate` (String) Available aggregation levels for data exported in `identified` targets. Only `person` is supported for targets with options.type = `lookup_api`.

Optional:

- `impute_payload` (List of String) Which payload elements to include imputed values for. Imputation uses cohabitants and neighbors to estimate missing values. Empty array means no imputed values appear in the target's payload.
- `output_multiple_identities` (Boolean) Allows additional historical address, email, and phone per row in json array format. A special plan feature is required for this to work, please contact support.
- `transform_preset` (String) One of: * default: Faraday default identified representation * linkedin: Plaintext upload format for Linkedin * youtube: Plaintext upload format for Youtube * klaviyo: Plaintext upload format for Klaviyo * segment: Plaintext upload format for Segment * iterable: Plaintext upload format for Iterable * poplar: Plaintext upload format for Poplar * salesforce: Plaintext upload format for Salesforce * hubspot: Plaintext upload format for Hubspot * address_only: Plaintext upload format for address only * liveramp: Plaintext upload format for LiveRamp If not specified `default` is used.


<a id="nestedatt--representation--referenced"></a>
### Nested Schema for `representation.referenced`

Required:

- `reference` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--representation--referenced--reference))

Optional:

- `impute_payload` (List of String) Which payload elements to include imputed values for. Imputation uses cohabitants and neighbors to estimate missing values. Empty array means no imputed values appear in the target's payload.
- `output_multiple_identities` (Boolean) Allows additional historical address, email, and phone per row in json array format. A special plan feature is required for this to work, please contact support.
- `reference_dataset_id` (String) **Deprecated:** use reference instead The referenced dataset ID. This dataset must have a `reference_key_column`.
- `transform_preset` (String) One of: * default: Faraday default referenced representation If not specified `default` is used.

### Nested Schema for `representation.referenced.reference`

Required:

- `dataset_id` (String) dataset id to reference




<a id="nestedatt--analysis_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `analysis_config`

Optional:

- `attributes` (List of String) Configuration for the analysis of attributes. Your account must have an identity graph feature store set. Faraday provided attributes must be prefixed with `fig/` ex. `fig/age`.
- `geographies` (List of String) Configuration for the analysis of geographic dimensions
- `traits` (List of String) Configuration for the analysis of traits. For traits created through `output_to_traits` via `/datasets`, specify the trait name. For traits from Faraday's Internal Graph (FIG), specify the name prefixed by `fig/` ex. `fig/age`.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_structure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_structure`

Read-Only:

- `aggregation` (String) The method of aggregation. Applies to aggregation targets only.
- `aggregation_criteria` (String) For scope columns that can be aggregated with `countif` (currently just persona sets), this is the value being counted (i.e. the persona ID). Applies to aggregation targets only.
- `is_identity_col` (Boolean) Set this to true when exporting first party identifiers (given by <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createdataset">identity_sets</a>). If `true`, `scope_col` represents the dataset field name being selected (ex: "client_email").
- `output_col` (String) The name of this column in the target export. Can be the same as `scope_col`.
- `scope_col` (String) The name of the scope column to export. Users can supply either the machine-readable name (with underscored uuid) or the human-readable name (with literates).

Optional:

- `attribute` (Attributes List) List of conditions to filter attributes. Your account must have an identity graph set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--attribute))
- `cohort_membership` (Attributes List) List of conditions to filter cohort membership on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--cohort_membership))
- `outcome_percentile` (Attributes List) List of conditions to filter outcome percentile on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--outcome_percentile))

- `persona` (Attributes List) List of conditions to filter persona set personid on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--persona))
- `recommender_rank` (Attributes List) List of conditions to filter recommender rank on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--recommender_rank))

<a id="nestedatt--filter--attribute"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.attribute`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the attribute.

Optional:

- `_eq` (String) Equal to

<a id="nestedatt--limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limit`

Optional:

- `percentile` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limit--percentile))
- `row_count` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limit--row_count))

<a id="nestedatt--limit--percentile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limit.percentile`

Required:

- `outcome_id` (String) Use the ranking suggested by the outcome's scores.
- `percentile_max` (Number) Specify a whole number to restrict the target to a maximum percentile score (inclusive).
- `percentile_min` (Number) Specify a whole number to restrict the target to a minimum percentile score (inclusive).


<a id="nestedatt--limit--row_count"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limit.row_count`

Required:

- `threshold` (Number) Specify a whole number to restrict the target to a specific number of records.

Optional:

- `direction` (String) When an `outcome_id` is given, this parameter sets the sort direction: for the "top" scores, specify `descending`. For the "bottom" scores, specify `ascending`. If not specified, defaults to `descending`.
- `outcome_id` (String) Use the ranking suggested by the outcome's scores.



<a id="nestedatt--final_structure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `final_structure`

Read-Only:

- `aggregation` (String) The method of aggregation. Applies to aggregation targets only.
- `aggregation_criteria` (String) For scope columns that can be aggregated with `countif` (currently just persona sets), this is the value being counted (i.e. the persona ID). Applies to aggregation targets only.
- `is_identity_col` (Boolean) Set this to true when exporting first party identifiers (given by <a href="https://faraday.ai/developers/reference/createdataset">identity_sets</a>). If `true`, `scope_col` represents the dataset field name being selected (ex: "client_email").
- `output_col` (String) The name of this column in the target export. Can be the same as `scope_col`.
- `scope_col` (String) The name of the scope column to export. Users can supply either the machine-readable name (with underscored uuid) or the human-readable name (with literates).
